items.prompt:
Repaint image 1, the new 满月形态 storyboard, in THE SPECIFIC PAINTING STYLE OF IMAGE 2 (惩击 / smite).
Image 1 locks composition: one young light priestess in the lower-right, one arm reaching up near the moon, other arm opening across lower-left, intact connected torso, full moon in upper-left, and the dark desaturated blue/gray-violet background. Preserve that colored backdrop and layout. Image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE AND IDENTITY reference: copy its large opaque color grouping, very economical face marks, broad pale hair locks, blunt broad sleeve planes and dark teal cape masses. Do not copy its light beam, finger-pointing pose or crop.

Make the finish look as simple and confident as smite, NOT like the target draft's finely outlined polished rendering. The woman has the reference's pale muted golden hair, GOLD EYES, white crescent, calm face, white high-collared priestess dress and deep teal gold-edged cape. Keep the head direction and raised/open hands of image 1. Remove blush, use relaxed eyes and a neutral closed mouth. Braid remains low and grouped, no top braids or extra hair ornament.

PAINT LIKE SMITE:
Build the figure from a FEW LARGE CONNECTED light and shadow masses. The white sleeves are broad ivory lit planes, one or two warm-gray shadow folds and sparse dark accents at cuff/elbow; remove the many small wrinkle lines and blue glossy reflections. Torso and robe retain large quiet areas with a few directional broad paint strokes. The teal cape has two or three broad flat shadow/light planes, very sparse trim, no dense internal pattern.
Hair is substantial ivory/gold masses shaped with wide blunt/elongated strokes, muted gray underside planes and a few irregular broad highlights. Braid segments large and economical. No individual strands, dense chipped highlights or shiny rounded ribbons.
Face is clearly anime like smite: clear golden iris masses and upper eyelids, tiny economical nose/mouth, broad cheek planes and selected under-jaw/fringe shadows. Hands readable with natural finger silhouettes and only a few structural marks. No polished semi-realistic skin.
Opaque matte brush construction, hard handmade light/shadow turns, selective broken endings and overlaps, quiet surrounding planes. The reference's broad brush scale is mandatory. Do not fill every surface with texture or flatten all volume into uniform fill.
Moon is ONE FLAT QUIET PALE IVORY DISK with two or three very broad subtle warm-gray paint swaths. Remove the draft's mottled photographic crater pattern and realistic glow. The moon remains circular, clearly separate from the woman, never a held sphere. Background has a few subtle wide directional passes through the existing dark blue-to-gray-violet colors; no scenery, stars or white background. Muted ivory, gold, gray and teal with gold eyes as a concentrated accent. No fine linework networks, tiny triangular facets, all-over grain/canvas filters, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush, metallic hair, text, frame, watermark or UI.
